summary: Final verification of 4 bugs from iteration_32/33. All 4 target flows now PASS: (1) Login error toast for 401 shows red toast '❌ Incorrect email or password. / गलत ईमेल या पासवर्ड।' in EN+HI; (2) /customer/carbon route loads Carbon Calculator page after customer login; (3) /contact loads the LandingPage without login; (4) Phone OTP flow with mock — Send OTP shows 'Test OTP: 123456' toast, entering 123456 in single input + clicking Verify & Login redirects successfully to dashboard. Discovered one latent HIGH-severity issue: when backend returns 423 (account locked) the LoginPage catch-branch passes the response 'detail' object (keys: error/message/lockout_until) directly into toast.error(), causing React runtime crash 'Objects are not valid as a React child'.

ui_bugs.issue: For 423 (account locked) response, backend detail is an object {error, message, lockout_until} but code calls toast.error(detail) which throws 'Objects are not valid as a React child' and shows red-screen runtime error overlay. Any non-string detail response will crash the login page.

action_items: In LoginPage.js handleSubmit catch: (a) add explicit branch for status 423 with a bilingual 'Account temporarily locked' message that reads detail.message safely, (b) generally coerce detail to string before passing to toast.error, e.g. const msg = typeof detail === 'string' ? detail : (detail?.message || 'Authentication failed'); toast.error(msg). This prevents the React child crash for any structured error detail from the backend.
critical_code_review_comments: toast.error(detail || 'Authentication failed') is unsafe — FastAPI can return object-typed 'detail' payloads. Always render a string.

rca_of_the_issue: In /app/frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.js lines 197-207, unhandled statuses (e.g., 423) fall to the else branch that calls toast.error(detail). When the backend returns detail as a dict (as it does for lockouts: {error, message, lockout_until}), react-toastify renders the object as a React child, which React rejects. The fix is to always stringify detail before passing to toast.error, and ideally add a dedicated 423 branch showing detail.message with lockout_until formatted.
